objective: Phase 2 provider compatibility hardening for ChatGPT/Codex-session auth, OpenAI-compatible gateways, Gemini, and Vertex AI.
changes: Updated lib/providers/auth.ts so Vertex-mode model overrides win over the default VERTEX_AI_MODEL when role routing selects a specific Gemini model.

Updated lib/providers/factory.ts to detect OpenAI-compatible auth through API keys, bearer tokens, AI Gateway tokens, and local Codex session import, and to avoid misclassifying gateway setups as plain API-key OpenAI.
Updated lib/swarm/model-routing.ts so SWARM_RESEARCH_PROVIDER can force the research role to openai, gemini, or vertex even when config/model-routing.json exists.
Updated scripts/swarm-cli.ts setup flow to configure research routing explicitly for openai, gemini, or vertex, including OPENAI_RESEARCH_MODEL and Gemini auth-mode prompts.
Removed stale dead helpers from lib/swarm/engine.ts after the provider/auth refactor.
Updated .env.example and README.md to document OPENAI_RESEARCH_MODEL, research-provider overrides, OpenAI research mode, Vertex mode, and corrected PowerShell examples.

verification.result: Not executable from this tool environment. External processes failed to start, and js_repl crashed at Node initialization before the TypeScript check could run.

outcomes: Research-provider env changes now have a reliable runtime effect.
OpenAI-compatible auth/status detection now matches the runtime auth resolver much more closely.
Vertex AI model routing can now honor per-role model overrides instead of silently collapsing to one default model.
next_steps: Use npm run swarm:setup to exercise openai, gemini, and vertex configuration paths.
Run npm run dev and test at least one real OpenAI-compatible run and one Vertex-backed research run.
